title: Terucon project overview
tagline: An Express website with the Design Studio mounted in it, and a site that is written as data.

hero.heading: A website with a design studio in it, and a site written as data
hero.lead: Four pages are served by one small Express server, with the Design Studio (Swatchroom) mounted in the same process. The landing page wakes the studio's GPU services as it opens, so they are usually ready by the first scan. The studio itself is kept in swatchroom/ exactly as it was built (its own guides are there). This page is generated from the tree: the files, line counts, routes, tests and variables below were read from the project when it was built.
